summary: The camera case matches all 30 screens and cursors but still diverges in RNG at zero-based step 29. dothrow.c:breakobj skips release_camera_demon: C draws the helper’s rn2(3) gate, while JavaScript records a gap and begins the next turn. Port whole release_camera_demon and await it from the existing EXPENSIVE_CAMERA arm, preserving creation, visibility/hallucination messaging, cursed peacefulness and set_malign order.

source.branch: An expensive camera is thrown south into the nearby wall. Existing breaktest and breakmsg reach breakobj’s EXPENSIVE_CAMERA case; its discarded-result release_camera_demon call occurs before shop accounting and object deletion. In the recorded case rn2(3)=2, so C does not create a demon; the missing gate draw is still required. When the gate is zero, a second rn2(3) selects homunculus for nonzero or imp for zero, then makemon(MM_NOMSG) can return a monster or null. A returned monster is announced only when canspotmon is true, using a random monster name only under Hallucination, then its peacefulness becomes !obj.cursed and set_malign follows.
